publisher.description: Declared by the pack author. It does not establish who published the pack.

status.description: Declared by the pack author. A scan allows "verified" only when the pack's files hash to a digest the scanning binary pins; the declaration alone is denied.

signature_ref.description: A label. HELM defines no SkillPack signature format, so the scan does not resolve or check it.

publisher_key_ref.description: A label. The scan holds no publisher key and does not resolve or check it.

policy_ref.description: The policy the pack author says applies. The scan judges every pack under its own built-in policy and never reads this one.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of SKILL.md, checked for consistency. It covers one file and is written by the pack author, so it is not the digest a publisher check uses.
